claim: Changi taxi to city is metered S$25-45 plus S$6-8 airport surcharge and a 50% midnight surcharge; private transfer car S$55-60.
quote: Taxi fare to city S$25–S$45; Airport surcharge: S$6–S$8; Midnight surcharge: 50% of fare (12:00 AM–5:59 AM); Airport Transfer Service S$55 (4-seater) or S$60 (6-seater)

claim: Changi MRT to central stations costs S$1.50-2.20 and takes ~35 min; Grab to the city is S$20-35 with no airport surcharge.
quote: MRT from Changi Airport station to key central stations costs SGD 1.50-2.20 per person... about 35 minutes. Grab: SGD 20-35... no airport surcharge

claim: SimplyGo lets tourists tap contactless cards/phones on all MRT and buses; adult fares run S$1.28-2.57 after the 27 Dec 2025 fare adjustment.
quote: Adult card fares start at $1.28 for journeys up to 3.2 km and rise in steps to a maximum of about $2.57... following the fare adjustment effective 27 December 2025

claim: Singapore Tourist Pass gives unlimited bus/MRT/LRT travel at S$17/24/29 for 1/2/3 days, excluding Sentosa Express.
quote: 1-Day: SGD $17; 2-Day: SGD $24; 3-Day: SGD $29... Exclusions include premium services such as Sentosa Express, RWS8, and express buses

claim: KTM Shuttle Tebrau is a 5-minute train from Woodlands to JB Sentral costing S$5; the Woodlands counter is cashless (KTM Wallet only).
quote: The KTM Shuttle Tebrau is a 5-minute train from SG to JB costing $5... The Woodlands counter is KTM Wallet only as KTMB went fully cashless on 1 January 2025

claim: Cross-border public buses to Johor Bahru cost roughly S$1.28-1.38 each way and run frequently.
The RTS Link rail between Woodlands North and Bukit Chagar is due to open around January 2027 at a fare of S$5-7.
quote: The RTS Link will launch in January 2027 as a faster, more frequent alternative, with a fare expected between S$5 and S$7

claim: Batam ferries from HarbourFront or Tanah Merah cost S$58-80 return plus a S$10 departure fee, take 45-60 min, with four operators and 60+ daily sailings.
quote: Return economy fares for Batam routes from HarbourFront: SGD 58–80 return... Singapore Passenger Departure Fee of $10 per person... 45–60 minutes... 60+ daily sailings across four operators

claim: A same-day Bintan getaway via Bintan Resort Ferries from Tanah Merah costs ~S$87, takes ~70 min, and drops at Lagoi Bay near the beaches; best March-October.
quote: A same-day getaway to Bintan Resorts costs just S$87 per person... drop-off will be in Bintan's Lagoi Bay, close to the resorts... best time to visit Bintan is during the dry season from March to October

claim: All travellers must submit the free SG Arrival Card online within 3 days of arrival; it is mandatory but is not a visa.
quote: All travellers are required to submit the SG Arrival Card within three (3) days (including the day of arrival) before arriving in Singapore... The SGAC is not a visa

claim: EU passport holders enter Singapore visa-free for up to 30 days; passport must be valid 6+ months with a confirmed onward ticket.
quote: EU passport holders can enter Singapore without a visa for up to 30 days... Passport validity must be minimum 6 months from the date of arrival... need a confirmed return or onward flight ticket

claim: The Pulau Ubin bumboat from Changi Point costs S$4 each way (cash only), takes ~15 min, and departs once 9-12 passengers board.
quote: The Pulau Ubin ferry costs S$4 per person per trip, and you pay the boat operator directly in cash... the boat ride takes about 15 minutes each way... they leave whenever there are 9 to 12 passengers on board

claim: Pulau Ubin is a kampong-era nature island (Chek Jawa wetlands, cycling) managed by NParks.
quote: Visit Pulau Ubin

claim: One round-trip ferry from Marina South Pier covering St John's, Lazarus and Kusu costs S$15 for adults.
quote: The adult fare for a round-trip ferry ticket is $15 (SGD 15)... One ticket is valid for a return trip to and from St. John's/Lazarus and Kusu Island

claim: Southern-island ferries leave Marina South Pier; in 2026 St John's main jetty is closed (re-routed to Lazarus) and Big Sisters' weekday trips are suspended.
quote: Trips to Big Sister's Island will be temporarily suspended on weekdays... St John's Island Main Jetty is closed for repairs; services are re-routed to Pulau Seringat Jetty (Lazarus Island)

claim: The Southern Ridges is a free 10 km walk linking 4 parks over the 36 m Henderson Waves bridge, with MRT stations at both ends.
quote: The Southern Ridges comprises one of the most stunning hiking trails... spanning a total length of 10km and connecting 4 parks... Henderson Waves Bridge is the highest pedestrian bridge in Singapore, standing about 36 meters

claim: Sections of the Southern Ridges walk are closed for works until July 2026, degrading the full-ridge experience.
quote: The walk is closed until July 2026 so whilst Henderson waves is open and nice the adjoining walks being closed makes the experience poor overall

claim: The Sentosa cable car round-trip Sky Pass costs S$35 adult / S$25 child and runs 08:45-22:00.
quote: A round-trip Sky Pass for an adult costs S$35, while a round-trip pass for a child (aged 4 to 12) costs S$25... runs daily from 8:45am to 10:00pm

claim: The Sentosa Express monorail costs S$4 for island admission (rides within Sentosa and back to the mainland are free); the Sentosa Boardwalk from VivoCity is free.
quote: The Sentosa Express costs S$4 for island admission... Travel within Sentosa and from Sentosa back to the mainland is free of charge... Entry via the Sentosa Boardwalk is free

claim: A Johor Bahru day trip from Singapore offers cheap food and malls like City Square, with round-trip bus transport about S$6-10.
quote: transport (round trip) of SGD 6-10 by bus, and food for the day of MYR 50-80

claim: Legoland Malaysia added a new MINILAND Singapore in 2026.
quote: A brand-new MINILAND Singapore has been added to LEGOLAND in 2026

claim: A one-day Legoland Malaysia ticket costs around MYR 199 for adults.
quote: a one-day theme park ticket costs around MYR 199 for adults and MYR 159 for children

claim: Singapore has 730+ km of cycling paths and park connectors plus a 360 km island-wide Park Connector Network.
quote: There are over 730km of cycling paths and park connectors... Park Connector Network (PCN) is a 360km island-wide network of dedicated recreation paths

claim: Tourist bike rental (e.g. GoCycling) costs from ~S$10/hour, with self-service bikes around S$10-20 per day.
quote: GoCycling has 13 outlets across the island... rates starting at $10 per hour... self-service bikes range from SGD $10-20 per day

claim: 1 Singapore dollar is worth about 0.67 EUR in June 2026.
quote: the exchange rate is 0.6735 Euros per Singapore Dollar as of June 9, 2026
